by_category:
by_category
	| cents_by_category result |
	cents_by_category := Dictionary new.
	(state at: 'expenses' ifAbsent: [ #() ]) do: [ :each |
		| category |
		category := each at: 'category'.
		cents_by_category
			at: category
			put: ((cents_by_category at: category ifAbsent: [ 0 ]) + (self cents: (each at: 'amount'))) ].
	result := Dictionary new.
	cents_by_category keysAndValuesDo: [ :category :cents | result at: category put: (self money: cents) ].
	^ result
total:
total
	^ self money: ((state at: 'expenses' ifAbsent: [ #() ])
		inject: 0
		into: [ :sum :each | sum + (self cents: (each at: 'amount')) ])
top_category:
top_category
	| totals best |
	totals := self by_category.
	totals isEmpty ifTrue: [ ^ nil ].
	best := nil.
	totals keysAndValuesDo: [ :category :amount |
		best isNil
			ifTrue: [ best := category ]
			ifFalse: [
				((self cents: amount) > (self cents: (totals at: best))
					or: [ ((self cents: amount) = (self cents: (totals at: best))) and: [ category < best ] ])
						ifTrue: [ best := category ] ] ].
	^ best
over_budget:
over_budget
	| spent budgets |
	spent := self by_category.
	budgets := state at: 'budgets' ifAbsent: [ Dictionary new ].
	^ ((budgets keys select: [ :category |
		(self cents: (spent at: category ifAbsent: [ 0 ])) > (self cents: (budgets at: category)) ]) asSortedCollection) asArray
add_expense:
add_expense: amount category: category
	| expenses cents |
	((amount isKindOf: Number) and: [ (cents := self cents: amount) > 0 ])
		ifFalse: [ self error: 'amount must be greater than zero' ].
	((category isKindOf: String) and: [ category notEmpty ])
		ifFalse: [ self error: 'category is required' ].
	expenses := state at: 'expenses' ifAbsentPut: [ OrderedCollection new ].
	expenses add: (Dictionary new
		at: 'amount' put: (self money: cents);
		at: 'category' put: category;
		yourself).
	^ expenses size

add_expense: amount category: category note: note
	| expenses cents |
	((amount isKindOf: Number) and: [ (cents := self cents: amount) > 0 ])
		ifFalse: [ self error: 'amount must be greater than zero' ].
	((category isKindOf: String) and: [ category notEmpty ])
		ifFalse: [ self error: 'category is required' ].
	note isNil ifTrue: [ self error: 'breaks expenses-shape' ].
	(note isKindOf: String)
		ifFalse: [ self error: 'note must be a string' ].
	expenses := state at: 'expenses' ifAbsentPut: [ OrderedCollection new ].
	expenses add: (Dictionary new
		at: 'amount' put: (self money: cents);
		at: 'category' put: category;
		at: 'note' put: note;
		yourself).
	^ expenses size
set_budget:
set_budget: category amount: amount
	| budgets cents |
	((amount isKindOf: Number) and: [ (cents := self cents: amount) >= 0 ])
		ifFalse: [ self error: 'amount must be zero or greater' ].
	budgets := state at: 'budgets' ifAbsentPut: [ Dictionary new ].
	budgets at: category put: (self money: cents).
	^ self money: cents
